hard_gates.rationale: Handpan left/right Slap produced the dedicated profile mapping in the retained real-device trace; mapper regression tests passed.
CoreMIDI packet timestamps were retained, but this run has no independent engine-dispatch timestamp from which callback-to-engine jitter can be computed without fabrication.
EC-001 release measurement completed 3/3 one-minute trials; final absolute drift max was 0.006 ms against the 5 ms threshold.
60 Hz, 120 Hz, and intentional frame-stall judgement records all equal the shared golden result.
The actual trace records present, absent, present and six mapped strikes with zero native queue drops.
A fresh project import, EditMode suite, release build, slice generation, and capture are CLI-driven with zero GUI interventions.

items.rationale: Three release-device sessions had zero drops/unknown mappings and release audio drift passed EC-001, but dispatch jitter remains Not Measured.
CLI test/build/capture work with zero GUI interventions, with Unity licensing and a maintained native CoreMIDI plugin.
Domain separation is clear, but the native CoreMIDI bridge adds platform-specific code and lifecycle handling.
Deterministic 768x768 output, frame-independent kinematics, and zero-allocation pool tests pass; comparable release frame time is not measured.
Clean release build completed in 12 seconds and three warmed measured builds had 3.316-second p50.
The desktop native MIDI bridge cannot be reused by WebGL without a separate Web MIDI adapter.
The selected LTS toolchain is mature but subject to Unity licensing and editor activation requirements.

hard_gates.rationale: Handpan left/right Slap produced the dedicated profile mapping in the retained real-device trace; mapper regression tests passed.
The standard adapter arrival-handling spread was 0.069 ms p95 over 24 retained messages, below the fixed 5 ms target; this is not physical or CoreMIDI latency.
EC-001 release measurement completed 3/3 one-minute trials; final absolute drift max was 3.155 ms against the 5 ms threshold.
60 Hz, 120 Hz, and intentional frame-stall judgement records all equal the shared golden result.
Godot kept the port listed, stopped receiving while disconnected, and automatically resumed; six mapped strikes were retained across the disconnect.
A fresh project import, headless suite, release export, slice generation, and capture are CLI-driven with zero GUI interventions.

items.rationale: Three release-device sessions normalized every trigger, arrival spread passed, reconnect recovered, and CoreAudio release drift passed EC-001.
CLI test/export/capture work with zero GUI interventions; the clean-cache defect was found and fixed from text source.
Typed GDScript and the standard MIDI API avoid a native plugin, with a known limitation in disconnect visibility.
Deterministic 768x768 output and frame-independent kinematics pass; comparable release frame time is not measured.
Clean release export completed in 8 seconds and three warmed measured exports had 7.506-second p50; the universal export is substantially larger.
GDScript avoids C# restrictions for web export, though desktop InputEventMIDI still requires a separate web input path.
Godot is MIT-licensed and the fixed toolchain runs without account or license activation.

residual_risks: Unity input dispatch jitter remains Not Measured, so Unity is not eligible without risk acceptance.
Drift beyond one minute remains a Phase 1 measurement after EC-001.
Godot's public MIDI API does not expose physical disconnect state or OS receive timestamps.
